units.source_text: 且说新来的近江君，住在邸内北厅。

en.t: Now the newly arrived Lady Omi was living in the northern wing of the residence.

units.source_text: 内大臣虽然找了她来，心中却想：“怎么办呢？

en.t: Although the Inner Minister had brought her there, he thought to himself, "What am I to do?

units.source_text: 我迎接这个人来，真是多此一举啊。

en.t: It was truly unnecessary of me to welcome this person here.

units.source_text: 倘说因为世人讥评，所以送她回去，则又太轻率，近于儿戏了。

en.t: If I were to send her back because people criticize her, that would be far too rash, almost like child's play.

units.source_text: 就此养她在家里，则恐世人又将讥笑，以为这样不中用的女儿，我妄想教养好来。

en.t: But if I keep her here and raise her in the house, I fear people will laugh again, saying I am foolishly trying to refine such a useless daughter.

units.source_text: 这又是很讨厌。

en.t: That too would be very unpleasant.

units.source_text: 想来想去，还不如把她送到弘徽殿女御那里，就让她在宫中做个蠢宫女吧。

en.t: After thinking it over, it would be better to send her to the Kokiden Consort and let her serve in the palace as a foolish court lady.

units.source_text: 外人说她相貌极恶，其实并不若是其甚。”

en.t: People say her looks are dreadful, but in truth they are not quite that bad."

units.source_text: 此时弘徽殿女御正好归宁在家，内大臣就去探望她，对她言道：“你带了这个妹妹去吧。

en.t: At this time the Kokiden Consort happened to be at home on a visit to her family, so the Inner Minister went to see her and said, "Take this younger sister with you.

units.source_text: 吩咐你的老年侍女们，她有不懂规矩之处，要毫不客气地教导她，勿使她给青年侍女们取笑。

en.t: Tell your older attendants to teach her frankly wherever she does not understand proper manners, so that the young attendants will not laugh at her.

units.source_text: 这件事真糟糕，我的思虑太不周了。”

en.t: This matter has turned out badly; I was far too careless in my thinking."

units.source_text: 说着笑起来。

en.t: As he said this, he laughed.

units.source_text: 女御答道：“哪里的话？

en.t: The consort replied, "Surely not.

units.source_text: 决不像别人所说的那样坏。

en.t: She is certainly not as bad as people say.

units.source_text: 只是中将等预料她是个盖世无双的美人，估计太高，教她赶不上罢了。

en.t: It is only that the Captain and the others expected her to be an incomparable beauty, and their expectations were too high for her to meet.

units.source_text: 外人如此讥笑，使她难受，因此她心中不快吧。”

en.t: People's ridicule must have hurt her, and that is probably why she feels unhappy."

units.source_text: 这应对很有礼貌。

en.t: This reply was very courteous.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御相貌并非十全无缺，但气品高雅，神情清丽，加之态度和蔼可亲。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort's appearance was not flawless, but she had an elegant air, a clear and graceful expression, and a gentle, approachable manner.

units.source_text: 内大臣看了她那富有风韵的笑颜，觉得这女儿毕竟与众不同。

en.t: Seeing her charming smile, the Inner Minister felt that this daughter was, after all, unlike ordinary people.

units.source_text: 便对她说道：“总而言之，是中将年轻，思虑不周之故。”

en.t: He then said to her, "In short, it was because the Captain was young and thoughtless."

units.source_text: 如此议论，实在委屈了这个近江君。

en.t: To speak of the Lady Omi in this way was truly unfair to her.
